description: Icons are identified by order. Scope: spans every project (no project filter). To act on a single project, use `postProjectIcons` instead. Effect: creates a new resource. Repeating this call may create additional resources; it is not guaranteed idempotent. Tip: set `dry_run: true` first to validate the arguments and preview the exact request without sending it to Polarion. The executor returns this preview as normal text, and as structured content when the tool declares an output schema.

dry_run.description: If true, validates the request and returns the exact request that would be sent to Polarion — with the Authorization header redacted and any binary payload summarized by byte length — without actually sending it.

requestBody.description: Icon meta data and file data

name: postGlobalIcons
